source: ENTSO-E A44; system price Nord Pool
method: Unsmoothed average of the same month/day in 2021–2025. Feb 29 uses the available leap years. A day is the mean of all complete Europe/Zurich delivery-hour or 15-minute prices. Country values are equal-weight bidding-zone averages, not load-weighted. Nordic is the official Nord Pool system price.
notes: Nordic (official Nord Pool system price) history starts 2024-01-01; Nord Pool AggregatePrices returns HTTP 401 for SYS years before 2024. Bidding-zone normals use 2021–2025. Nordic uses the years actually on file, currently 2024–2025.

columns.monthly_normal: monthly_normal[region][MM] with normal, min, max, n_years
